# English is Easy

> A comprehensive online English learning platform specializing in exam preparation and interactive grammar, vocabulary, and listening practice for Russian students.

English is Easy (englishiseasy.ru) offers thousands of practice tests and learning resources tailored for EGE and OGE exam preparation, along with extensive grammar tutorials, vocabulary collections, and phrase guides. The platform serves Russian secondary school and university students preparing for standardized English language examinations.

## Key Topics

- EGE exam preparation
- OGE exam preparation
- Grammar tests
- Verb tenses
- Present Simple
- Past Simple
- Present Perfect
- Vocabulary by topics
- English phrases
- Multiple-choice quizzes
- Verb conjugation
- Intermediate-level exercises
- Listening comprehension
- Grammar articles
- English learning

## Exam Preparation

- [EGE Exam Preparation Tests 2026](https://englishiseasy.ru/ege): EGE exam preparation with practice tests and explanations for Russian students.
- [OGE Exam Preparation Tests 2026](https://englishiseasy.ru/oge): OGE exam preparation with thousands of tasks for Russian secondary school students.

## Grammar Tests & Exercises

- [Present Simple, Past Simple. Test 1](https://englishiseasy.ru/test2): Grammar test on Present Simple and Past Simple tenses with multiple-choice questions.
- [Present Simple, Present Perfect. Test 2](https://englishiseasy.ru/test3): Grammar test comparing Present Simple and Present Perfect tenses.
- [Present Simple. Test 3](https://englishiseasy.ru/test7): Present Simple tense practice test with intermediate-level multiple-choice questions.
- [Present Perfect, Present Perfect Continuous. Test 4](https://englishiseasy.ru/test8): Grammar test on Present Perfect and Present Perfect Continuous tenses.
- [Present Simple. Test 5](https://englishiseasy.ru/test23): Present Simple verb conjugation practice with multiple-choice quiz format.
- [Past Simple. Test 6](https://englishiseasy.ru/test24): Past Simple tense practice test for intermediate English learners.
- [Future Simple. Test 7](https://englishiseasy.ru/test25): Future Simple tense practice quiz with verb conjugation exercises.
- [Present Perfect. Test 8](https://englishiseasy.ru/test26): Present Perfect tense grammar test with multiple-choice questions.
- [Past Perfect. Test 9](https://englishiseasy.ru/test27): Past Perfect tense grammar test with intermediate-level multiple-choice questions.
- [Future Perfect. Test 10](https://englishiseasy.ru/test28): Future Perfect tense practice test for intermediate English learners.
- [Present Continuous. Test 11](https://englishiseasy.ru/test29): Present Continuous tense grammar test with verb conjugation practice.
- [Past Continuous. Test 12](https://englishiseasy.ru/test30): Past Continuous tense grammar test with multiple-choice format.
- [Future Continuous. Test 13](https://englishiseasy.ru/test31): Future Continuous tense grammar test with verb conjugation exercises.

## Learning Resources

- [Grammar and Vocabulary Articles](https://englishiseasy.ru/articles): Grammar and vocabulary articles covering tenses, word selections, and language differences.
- [English Vocabulary by Topics](https://englishiseasy.ru/vocabulary): Thematic vocabulary collections with translations and transcriptions for learners.
- [English Phrases by Topics](https://englishiseasy.ru/phrases): English phrases by topics including conversations, directions, and practical expressions.
